nodes.name: RSE - Shoulder Or Saddle - Unofficial Patch Fix
nodes.summary: The patch makes RSE - Shoulder Or Saddle 1.4 work on Skyrim 1.7.104 and 1.6.170 and fixes many bugs of the original mod. It requires the original mod: it only replaces its three SKSE DLLs and some of its Papyrus scripts.

nodes.name: Unofficial Patch - Bug Fixes for Graveyard Keeper 2
nodes.summary: Fixes about 80 bugs in Graveyard Keeper 2 (PC, 1.009): story hard locks, talents that don't do what they say, zombie workers that freeze, wrong prices and texts. Saves a bug already broke are repaired on load. Every fix can be switched off
